title: Evidence-Governed Adoption of Self-Generated Updates in Autonomous AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents modify prompts, memories, tools, workflows, and policies using interaction histories. Yet a plausible modification is not necessarily suitable for persistent adoption: candidate selection is adaptive, evaluators may be imperfect, and local gains can hide degradation against an earlier baseline. We introduce Evidence-Governed Evolution (EGE), a framework for governing adoption of self-generated agent modifications. EGE separates candidate generation from confirmatory adoption, evaluates frozen candidates on fresh paired audits, requires meaningful improvement on a prespecified primary objective, protects declared capabilities through reference-relative non-inferiority tests, and applies governance constraints before bounded canary deployment. translated_title: 自主AI智能体中自我生成更新的证据治理式采纳
translated_abstract: 自主智能体利用交互历史来修改提示词、记忆、工具、工作流和策略。然而，一个看似合理的修改并不一定适合被持久采纳：候选选择是自适应的，评估器可能并不完善，且局部收益可能掩盖相对于早期基线的性能退化。我们提出了证据治理式进化框架，用于治理自我生成的智能体修改的采纳。EGE将候选生成与确认性采纳相分离，在新颖的成对审计上评估冻结的候选方案，要求在预先指定的主要目标上取得有意义的改进，通过相对于参照的非劣性检验保护已声明的能力，并在有限的金丝雀部署之前应用治理约束。我们针对可数的自适应生成候选序列建立了一种评估器校准的同步下界构造，该构造结合了逐候选的Hoeffding界……
tldr: 该论文提出证据治理式进化（EGE）框架，通过分离候选生成与确认性采纳、在新配对审计上评估冻结候选、要求主目标显著改进、以非劣性检验保护已声明能力并在金丝雀部署前施加治理约束，从而安全地治理自主智能体自我生成修改的持久采纳。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Evidence-Governed Evolution (EGE), a framework that safely governs persistent adoption of self-generated agent modifications by separating candidate generation from confirmatory adoption, evaluating frozen candidates on fresh paired audits, requiring meaningful improvement on a prespecified primary objective, protecting declared capabilities through non-inferiority tests, and applying governance constraints before bounded canary deployment.
